claims.text: MJP French editions Text: 1 January; publication: 21 February Separate named units

MJP’s French editions distinguish the United Provinces declaration at Tucumán from Chile’s act ordering Santiago deposit. Buenos Aires belongs to earlier junta context. Chile’s 1 January textual date differs from 21 February publication. Separate named acts establish neither every territory’s participation nor a completed deposit.
Are these one declaration made simultaneously by Buenos Aires and Santiago? Distinct named acts
claims.address: model.PREDICTION; question and both options; answer relation

claims.text: What does Chile’s act establish about Santiago custody? It orders the declaration deposited in Santiago municipality; this witness does not establish that the deposit occurred. The separate1816 declaration was at Tucumán.

United Provinces does not mean every territory of modern Argentina; Chile’s state declaration does not supply Mapuche consent. Tucumán is the 1816 declaration site; Chile’s 1 January text and 21 February publication remain distinct. Santiago deposit is ordered in the act, not an observed completed deposit; the same distinction binds stage, field, reveal and recall.
